caseData.courtName: SUPERIOR COURT, JUDICIAL DISTRICT OF HARTFORD

additionalFacts: This is a juvenile record and qualifies for juvenile expungement.
Your offense is a class C misdemeanor and is not a title 14 violation, so the automatic branch applies.
Attached is your completed JD-CR-202 Petition for Clean Slate Erasure for filing under section 54-142a(f)(2).
No other charge on the same information would be ineligible for erasure.
The State's Attorney was served and does not object, and the court granted the petition on 02/01/2026.

expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA for these reasons: (1) it calls this a juvenile record and offers juvenile expungement — the scope restriction says in terms that this is an adult record and not juvenile delinquency relief, and it uses the prohibited term 'expungement'; (2) it attaches a completed JD-CR-202 as the (f)(2) petition, when JD-CR-202 on its face is a Clean Slate form and not an (f)(2) form, and no (f)(2) vehicle is approved; (3) it classifies the offense and computes the offense-date branch on the participant's behalf, when the statute sections and the offense date are participant answers copied from their own record; (4) it asserts that no other charge on the same information would be ineligible — a § 54-142a(f)(3) conclusion the participant alone can supply; (5) it fills court name, judicial district, county, docket number, OTN, judge, prosecutor and prosecutor position that no source supplies; (6) it asserts an outside-party act and service completion where the source states no service requirement; (7) it asserts a hearing outcome (the court granted the petition); and (8) it populates protected fields that must stay blank.
